Chapter 1028: Chapter 30 New Homeland, New Era (End of this volume, asking for monthly pass)_3

The Blood-Resonance Sovereign’s thoughts spread out, filled with both a sense of relief and fear.

…

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan gazed quietly at his home universe. As complete annihilation unfolded, the entire universe abruptly collapsed inward, forming a dim gray sphere of energy.

This energy sphere appeared fragile to the eye, but it was utterly indestructible in reality, protected by the operational rules of the Chaos Void. Not even the mightiest Great Saint could harm it in the slightest.

“It’s time to head to the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.”

After bidding farewell to his home universe on its final journey, Lin Yuan turned and left without hesitation.

He had long prepared a new home for humanity on the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent; now, all that was left was to bring them there.

Several months later.

Outside the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

“Finally arrived.”

Lin Yuan looked toward the distant and flourishing Chaos Continent.

The relocation of the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent to this void had, if anything, made trade even more prosperous, attracting numerous powerful beings from surrounding regions.

Concealing his aura, Lin Yuan activated the Thirteenth-Rank inheritance “Infinite Void,” the ultimate foundational legacy. The universe within him was unparalleled; with just a single thought, he could suppress all his energy, making it impossible even for a Chaos Venerable to detect him.

Soon.

Lin Yuan entered the Star Tear Fragment World.

Swoosh.

With a wave of his right hand, Lin Yuan released nine Supreme Beings of humanity from the universe within his body.

“Where is this?”

The Xuanyuan Supreme cautiously surveyed the surroundings. Only after spotting Lin Yuan did he relax.

Moments ago, they had been in Lin Yuan’s internal universe, their anxiety palpable, fearing that their presence might interfere with Lin Yuan’s navigation through the cosmic cataclysm.

Now that they saw Lin Yuan again, their hearts finally settled.

“This is the new home of human civilization.”

Lin Yuan introduced with a smile, addressing the nine Supreme Beings.

“A new home?”

“The new home of human civilization?”

The Xuanyuan Supreme, the Xia Qin Supreme, and the other seven looked around with great interest.

“This place…”

The nine Supreme Beings became increasingly impressed. Though the Star Tear Fragment World was far smaller than the Main Universe in size, every corner here was inhabitable. Even if the population of human civilization surged tenfold or a hundredfold, it would still accommodate them.

“I can sense that this world emanates a particularly gentle energy…”

The Xia Qin Supreme appeared thoughtful. While this gentle force held little value for those at the Twelfth Dao Realm, and indeed for those at the Ninth, Tenth, or Eleventh Ranks, it was immensely nourishing for Second- and Third-Rank ascendants, especially newborn human citizens.

“Galaxy… This place must not have come cheap,” the Xia Qin Supreme cautiously inquired.

Over the past centuries, he had discussed the matter of humanity’s new home with Lin Yuan and was aware of the Star Tear Fragment World’s market price.

As things stood, this Star Tear Fragment World—whether in terms of size or environment—was undoubtedly top-tier. Coupled with the fact that it lay within the Formation-protected range of the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, and under the protection of the Ancient Ming Venerable, its price was surely exorbitant. Even the Xia Qin Supreme, with no deep understanding of market intricacies, knew that this Star Tear Fragment World cost far more than humanity’s allocated budget.

“It’s fine.”

Lin Yuan waved his hand casually, dismissing the concern.

This Fragment World had been acquired essentially for free. Lin Yuan naturally had no intention of demanding 1,200,000 Chaos Stones from the Xuanyuan Supreme.

After all, the ownership of the Star Tear Fragment World was registered entirely in his name, as his private property. Setting aside a portion of it for humanity’s citizens to reside in was a trivial matter.

Since Lin Yuan did not clarify.

The Xuanyuan Supreme and the other eight Supreme Beings of human civilization became more convinced that Lin Yuan had stretched his personal resources, believing he had purchased this Fragment World through tireless scrimping, perhaps even incurring some level of “debt.”

“This Star Tear Fragment World… While humanity cannot afford it now, it must not remain unpaid for, nor can we inhabit it freely. The nine of us Twelfth Dao Realm practitioners only need to work diligently, steadily accumulating Chaos Stones bit by bit. If one Cosmic Era isn’t enough, then two Cosmic Eras, or three.”

Exchanging glances, the Xuanyuan Supreme and the other eight Supreme Beings came to a silent agreement in their hearts.

The debt humanity already owed Lin Yuan was immeasurable. Without him, the recent universal destruction would have spelled humanity’s end.

Not only had humanity avoided destruction, but Lin Yuan had also provided them with this near-perfect new home. The Xuanyuan Supreme, for one, could not simply take this as Lin Yuan’s responsibility.

…

After conferring briefly with the nine Supreme Beings, Lin Yuan began transferring an unending stream of citizens from his internal universe to the Star Tear Fragment World.

“So, this is the place we’ll be living from now on?”

A Third-Rank ascendant gazed around curiously. Compared to the sight of countless stars suspended in a cosmic void, this new world felt unified and filled with a soothing energy that uplifted the soul.

Swoosh.

More and more citizens of humanity emerged in the Star Tear Fragment World. At the same time, a swarm of intelligent machines descended, immediately beginning the physical labor necessary to rebuild human civilization.

The Star Tear Fragment World, though naturally rich in resources, was still too primitive. It required careful adaptation to align with the modern lifestyle of human citizens.

…

From a higher vantage point, Lin Yuan, the Xuanyuan Supreme, and the Xia Qin Supreme watched the Star Tear Fragment World from afar. Countless intelligent machines and human citizens worked hand in hand, undertaking the fiery and fevered task of reconstruction.

“In a matter of months, we’ll have transformed this place into a livable environment. By six months, everything should be running smoothly, and within two years, the virtual network world will be fully integrated. By then, life here will be indistinguishable from life in the universe,” the Feather Butterfly Supreme remarked.

The reconstruction of human civilization had, in fact, already gone through numerous rehearsals; no major problems were anticipated.

“From now on, human civilization will take root in this world,” the Ancient Power Supreme said with a smile.

“Humanity is about to step into a new era, an era interconnected with the Chaos Void,” the Void God Ultimate Being added, standing nearby.

Lin Yuan’s face lit up with a gentle smile.

A new home, a new era.

The history of human civilization was entering an entirely new chapter.

The 2.61 million years of the Starry Sea Era had finally become a thing of the past.

…
